snippet.title: R.E.P.O – Indie World Showcase 10.28.2026
snippet.description:
R.E.P.O is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027!

R.E.P.O. is an online co-op horror game featuring physics, proximity voice chat, and scary monsters.

Under the employ of a mysterious computer intelligence, you and your friends must locate, transport, and extract valuable items from the haunted remains of a long-lost humanity. Take anything from heavy pianos to fragile ceramics, and use teamwork to make sure the precious cargo reaches its destination safely.

#IndieWorld #REPO
